description: Fetch the full details of one experience in Opplevagent's catalogue, such as a tasting or a producer visit, by its UUID. Henter fullstendig informasjon om en opplevelse via UUID. Returns title, full description, category, location (fylke/kommune/meeting point), indoor/outdoor, season, weather suitability, group size limits, age suitability, price, duration, languages, booking URL, and booking type. Obtain the UUID from discover_experiences results. Example: id 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'.

id.description: UUID of the experience to fetch. Example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'

name: get_experience
title: Get details for an experience, tasting or visit
